import analysis.normed_space.completion
import topology.bounded_continuous_function
import topology.group_action
import topology.seminormed_space
import topology.uniform_space.basic
import topology.uniform_space.cauchy
import topology.uniform_space.compact
import topology.uniform_space.continuous_map
import topology.uniform_space.quotient
import data.real.basic
import data.complex.upper_half_plane
import group_theory.matrix.special_linear_group

open Set Filter TopologicalSpace Classical

theorem lg_target {E : Type u_1} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] {f : UpperHalfPlane → E} (hf_cont : Continuous f) (hf_infinity : UpperHalfPlane.IsBoundedAtImInfty f) (hf_inv : ∀ (g : Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) (τ : UpperHalfPlane), f (g • τ) = f τ) : ∃ C, ∀ (τ : UpperHalfPlane), ‖f τ‖ ≤ C := by
  let D : Set UpperHalfPlane := { τ | 0 < Im τ ∧ Im τ ≤ 1 }
  have h_D_closed : IsClosed D := by
    apply is_closed_inter
    · exact is_closed_pos_im
    · exact is_closed_le_one_im
  have h_D_compact : Compact D := by
    apply compact_inter
    · exact compact_pos_im
    · exact compact_le_one_im
  have h_fundamental_domain : IsFundamentalDomain D (Matrix.SpecialLinearGroup (Fin 2) ℤ) := by
    apply is_fundamental_domain_of_discrete_action
    · exact is_discrete_special_linear_group
    · exact is_proper_action_special_linear_group
    · exact is_quotient_topology_upper_half_plane
    · exact is_surjective_special_linear_group_action
  have h_bounded_on_D : ∃ C₁, ∀ τ ∈ D, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C₁ := by
    let C₁ := sup {‖f τ‖ | τ ∈ D}
    use C₁
    intro τ
    cases τ with x y
    have h_closed : τ ∈ closure D := by
      rw [closure_eq_closure_subset]
      apply is_closed_subset
      · exact h_D_closed
      · exact mem_set_of_mem
    have h_continuous : Continuous (λ τ : UpperHalfPlane, ‖f τ‖) := by
      apply continuous_norm
      exact hf_cont
    have h_bounded : ∃ C, ∀ τ ∈ closure D, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C := by
      apply continuous_on_bounded_on
      · exact h_continuous
      · exact h_D_closed
    exact h_bounded
  have h_bounded_at_infinity : ∃ C₂, ∀ τ ∈ UpperHalfPlane \ D, ‖f τ‖ ≤ C₂ := by
    let C₂ := hf_infinity
    use C₂
    intro τ
    exact hf_infinity τ
  let C := max (sup {‖f τ‖ | τ ∈ D}) (hf_infinity)
  exact ⟨C, fun τ => max_le (le_max_left _ _) (le_max_right _ _)⟩
